name: io.github.whosman/stackblade
title: Stackblade
description: Substack writer follower counts, category leaderboards and recent rank moves.

tools.name: get_writer
tools.description: Current numbers for one Substack writer: followers, change over the last 7 and 30 days, the paid-subscriber band, current leaderboard positions and recommendation counts, with a link to the writer's page and its follower chart. Use it when someone asks how big a Substack writer or newsletter is, whether it is growing, or where it ranks. Accepts a handle, a profile link, a publication address, a custom domain or a name. When the writer is not tracked, the result says so and lists close matches.

handle.description: The writer: a Substack handle (kyla or @kyla), a profile link, a publication address such as kyla.substack.com or a custom domain, or the writer's name.

tools.name: board
tools.description: The top of one category's Substack leaderboard, with each writer's followers, paid band and move since the previous board. The result says when the board was read, matching the date on the category page. board is bestsellers (ranked by paid subscribers, the default) or rising (recent paid growth). category is a slug or name such as technology, business, culture or U.S. Politics; when it does not match, the result lists the closest categories.

category.description: A category slug or name, for example technology, us-politics or Food & Drink.

tools.name: recent_activity
tools.description: The latest leaderboard moves, follower milestones and new recommendations across the Substack writers Stackblade tracks, newest first, each with a link to the writer's page. kind is all (default), rank (leaderboard moves), rec (new recommendations) or followers (follower milestones). The free feed is delayed.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every Substack category Stackblade keeps leaderboards for, with its slug, its name and a link to its page. Each category has a bestsellers board and a rising board. Use it to find the right category for a leaderboard question.

tools.name: get_follow_links
tools.description: Links for a person who wants to keep following a Substack writer's growth, and for a writer who wants to claim their own page. Use it when the user asks to track, follow, watch or get updates on a writer (a reader, sponsor or brand), or says they are the writer. A reader gets the writer's page and a link that adds the writer to their watchlist once they confirm on the page; a writer gets a link to claim their page. Also says what the free plan and Pro include. Creates nothing: the person acts on the site.

handle.description: The writer: a Substack handle (kyla or @kyla), a profile link, a publication address such as kyla.substack.com or a custom domain, or the writer's name.

audience.description: reader (default): someone who wants to follow the writer. writer: the writer, who wants to claim their page.
